title: Texture Validation
description: Validates texture references across entities, blocks, items, particles, and UI elements. Tracks texture handle usage to prevent exceeding platform limits.

100.title: Handle Limit Exceeded
100.description: Error when the total number of unique texture handles exceeds platform limits. Mobile devices have lower limits than PC. Consider consolidating textures or using texture atlases.
100.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count of texture handles exceeding the limit

101.title: Textures
101.description: Count of unique texture paths referenced in the project from entities, blocks, items, particles, terrain_texture.json, and UI definitions.
101.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the count of unique texture references
